question: In accordance with the AMIF Regulation1, the Commission should report on the progress of the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (AMIF) towards achieving its specific objectives, including regarding the number of participants who received legal assistance. Has the Commission already reported on this indicator? If so, is this data available with a breakdown by Member State?

Are Member States adequately reporting to the Commission on legal assistance funded under AMIF, and are they required to provide information on the actors providing such assistance to asylum seekers, as well as on the type of legal assistance provided?

Does the Commission consider that reporting on the number of participants who received legal assistance is sufficient to assess the quality of the legal assistance provided to asylum seekers, and how will the Commission ensure that asylum seekers receive high-quality legal assistance funded under AMIF?

Regulation (EU) 2021/1147 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 7 July 2021 establishing the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (OJ L 251, 15.7.2021, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1147/oj). 1
